title: The Graceful movement of her hands
subtitle: 音乐之声 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）
meta: 主题语境：音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）　|　核心词汇：graceful　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 graceful 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the athlete wrote of ① a graceful movement of her hands in the programme, and everybody in the stadium said at once that it was ② more graceful than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the athlete, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the graceful ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most graceful movement of her hands anybody in the stadium had ever seen, or so the programme for September 1987 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too graceful to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the trainer who had come to help; the graceful ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a graceful exit from the stage, and said that no trainer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as graceful as the exit from the stage they had once had in the old stadium. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was graceful or not, and he said so.

By 2000 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something graceful, and nothing besides. The trainer from the next stadium called the whole plan ⑧ quite graceful; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the graceful ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2003, in silence, she wrote of another graceful movement of her hands in the same programme, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more graceful than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most graceful exit from the stage in the whole stadium, she said in 2005, was the one she could never quite name; the graceful ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 优雅（前置定语 a graceful movement of her hands：1993 年运动员在秩序册里记下的那件优雅的动作）
B. adj. 优雅／得体（比较级 more graceful than：文中两处，一处比她双手的动作，一处比预想）
C. adj. 优雅／得体（最高级 the most graceful：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 优雅（表语 too graceful to do：母亲觉得它太优雅，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 得体（前置定语 a graceful exit from the stage：叔叔把整件事称作一桩得体的地退场）
F. adj. 得体（同级比较 as graceful as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩得体地退场相比）
G. adj. 得体（后置定语 something graceful：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 得体（受程度副词修饰 quite graceful：那位陪练的评价）

items.q: a graceful movement of her hands
the most graceful movement of her hands anybody
a graceful exit from the stage
The most graceful exit from the stage in

answers.why: graceful 意为“优雅”，1993 年运动员在秩序册里记下的是“一件优雅的动作”，此处作前置定语 a graceful movement of her hands。
graceful 意为“优雅”，此处用比较级 more graceful than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
graceful 意为“优雅”，秩序册上 九月 那行字说它是体育场里最优雅的一件，故用最高级 the most graceful movement of her hands。
graceful 意为“优雅”，母亲认为这件东西“太优雅了，谁也用不上”，too graceful to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
graceful 意为“得体”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩得体的地退场”，此处作前置定语 a graceful exit from the stage。
graceful 意为“得体”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩得体地退场一样得体”，同级比较用 as graceful as。
graceful 意为“得体”，秩序册上那半行字要的是“得体的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something graceful。
graceful 意为“得体”，邻体育场来的那位陪练认为这套计划“相当得体”，quite 修饰原级 graceful。
graceful 意为“得体”，2003 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要得体”，故用比较级 more graceful than。
graceful 意为“得体”，母亲 2005 年说的是“整个体育场里最得体的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most graceful exit from the stage。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1993 年，运动员在秩序册里记下了一件优雅的动作。（a graceful movement of her hands）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更优雅。（more graceful than …）
母亲觉得它太优雅，谁也用不上。（too graceful to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩得体的地退场。（a graceful exit from the stage）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩得体地退场一样得体。（as graceful as …）
到了 2000 年，秩序册上只剩半行字：要的是一件得体的东西。（something graceful）
answers: In 1993 the athlete wrote of a graceful movement of her hands in the programme.
Everybody said it was more graceful than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too graceful to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a graceful exit from the stage.
He said nobody would call it as graceful as the exit from the stage they had once had.
By 2000 the programme asked for nothing but something graceful.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 graceful 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1993 the athlete wrote of a graceful movement of her hands in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most graceful movement of her hands in the stadium, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too graceful to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a graceful exit from the stage, and nobody argued with him.
The trainer from the next stadium called the plan quite graceful, and everybody laughed.
The graceful ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
